subject: SDLC artifacts request for ACME SIG review — PR approvals & deploy audit
messages:
From: Pauline Hart <pauline.hart@secureassess.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial evidence request: SDLC artifacts for ACME SIG review

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for taking this through with us. As part of ACME's SIG / vendor assessment we need a targeted bundle of SDLC evidence related to code review, CI/CD controls, secrets handling and change approvals. To scope the request, can you provide the following artifacts (redacted where appropriate):

1) Code review policy and a sample of PR approval logs (commits/PR ids, approvers, timestamps) for the core inference repo (redwood-inference).
2) CI/CD pipeline configuration (high-level YAML or screenshots) and a snapshot of a successful deployment run from Sept/Oct 2026.
3) Secrets management evidence: KMS usage logs or an access audit showing rotation events, a description of ephemeral credential usage, and the team responsible.
4) Change management records: a short extract of the CAB/approval trail for a recent production rollout (JIRA ticket ids, approver names, and timestamps).

Our assessor will accept archives or Drive links. Ideally we get the items above by EOD Thu 22 Oct so the review can proceed before the next audit window. If anything needs HIPA/PII redaction or an NDA, let us know immediately.

Thanks,
Pauline Hart
Senior Assessor — SecureAssess
pauline.hart@secureassess.com
[attachment: initial-evidence-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 12 KB)]

Thanks — we can provide everything requested. I'm attaching our latest code review guidelines and starting a collection on Drive for the other artifacts. A few notes up front:

- We will redact personal emails and API tokens from logs prior to delivery.
- For CI run artifacts we will provide a snapshot (build + deploy logs) with redaction markers and a verification checklist.
- KMS access audit will include a CSV with access events and rotation timestamps; we will remove raw key IDs where required and provide a verification hash.

Attachments included: code-review-guidelines-v3.pdf (policy + required checklist).
Drive folder (temp link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ACME-SIG-SDLC-2026 — I will populate it with the pipeline and JIRA extracts as they are ready.

I have looped in Rishi and Marissa to pull the CI/KMS extracts and in Aditya for approvals/CAB evidence. We'll target delivery by Thu EOD and advise if any items need legal redaction.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Rishi / Marissa —

Please pull the following and drop into the Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ACME-SIG-SDLC-2026) with the file naming below. Pauline is the external assessor and needs the artifacts by Thu EOD 22 Oct.

Items required:
- PR approval extract (csv or zip) for redwood-inference: include PR id, author, approver(s), timestamps, and merge commit id. File: pr-approval-extract-202609.zip
- CI/CD snapshot: pipeline YAML(s) and one successful run logs (build+deploy) from a September/October run. File: ci-pipeline-snapshot-20261001.zip
- KMS/access audit: CSV of KMS access events and rotation records for the last 90 days. File: kms-access-audit-20261001.csv
- Change management: short extract of the CAB approval for ticket(s) JIRA-4312 and JIRA-4278; include approver names and timestamps. File: cab-approval-extract.pdf

Notes: redact token strings and any customer data. Mark redaction points inline so Pauline can verify nothing was removed accidentally. If you anticipate any blocker (e.g., need an exception for key material), escalate to me and Aditya immediately.

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround here.
Lauren

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Action: gather CI logs & KMS audit for ACME SIG (JIRA-4312)

Lauren / team —

Work in progress. Quick summary of what I have and constraints:

1) PR approvals — I exported the PR metadata from our Git host for the redwood-inference repo (Sept 1 — Oct 15). Attached: pr-approval-extract-202609.zip. Fields included: pr_id, author, approvers, created_at, merged_at. Personal emails are hashed per our data handling policy.

2) CI snapshot — pipeline YAML and one run log (2026-10-01) are in ci-pipeline-snapshot-20261001.zip. Logs include agent IDs and internal hostnames; I have redacted hostnames and replaced with host-XXX markers.

3) KMS audit — attached kms-access-audit-20261001.csv. This is an export of KMS access events; raw key material is never exported. Rotation events are logged; rotation_event_id is present as a verification token rather than raw key id.

4) CAB approvals — I requested the JIRA approval exports and received a trimmed PDF: cab-approval-extract.pdf (contains approver name, role, and timestamp).

Attachments enclosed in Drive and attached here as stubs for the assessor. We followed the standard redaction checklist and annotated every redaction. If Pauline needs a verification hash for any redacted block, say the word and we'll produce it.

Deliverables are now in the Drive folder. ETA for any follow-up artifacts: Fri 23 Oct EOD for additional logs or verifier hashes.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
